note: Wording revisions the site's form builder applies to a card's workflow and promises. The frontier-written templates (app/core/templates/*.json) are frozen by the BUILDER-1 manifest (research/surface-20261021/eval/MANIFEST-fix.json), so the revisions live here: words only, never a step, a check, a capability, a state key or a stage value. Why: a live run makes DRAFTS the person sends from their own mail app, so 'sent', 'delivered' and 'went out' were false (walkthroughs P1-M7, P2-M5, P4-M11, P5-M2); the first reminder a customer got could say 'This is our second reminder' (P2-B4); acceptance checks with no plain sentence showed the machine text 'the delivered of ... equals true' (P2-M6, P1-M6). Every `replace` pair must match at least once (app/onboarding/test/card-text.test.mjs), so a template change cannot silently skip a revision. Text in [[name]] is the slot value (or the template's derived text); an entry {"if": slot, "text"} is kept only when the slot is set ("!slot": when it is not).
